patches.label: make offline tire-alert checks explicit and independent of installed preferences
patches.before: const probs = nightProblems({ lock: { value: 'Unlocked' }, rr: { value: 26 }, fl: { value: 35 }, fuel: { value: 9 } });
patches.after: const probs = nightProblems({ lock: { value: 'Unlocked' }, rr: { value: 26 }, fl: { value: 35 }, fr: { value: 35 }, rl: { value: 35 }, fuel: { value: 9 } }, { tireConfiguration: { configured: true, layout: 'four', frontPsi: 30, rearPsi: 30 }, alerts: { enabled: { tires: true } } });

patches.label: keep all-good offline check independent of active per-vehicle alerts
patches.before: assert(nightProblems({ lock: { value: 'Locked' }, fl: { value: 35 } }).length === 0, 'evening all good');
patches.after: assert(nightProblems({ lock: { value: 'Locked' }, fl: { value: 35 } }, {}).length === 0, 'evening all good');

patches.label: verify original countdown semantics and conservative unknown-profile presentation separately
patches.before: assert(rr.remote() && rr.remote().until > now(), 'unconfirmed stop does not hide running telemetry');
patches.after:
assert(MODEL_ORIGINAL_REMOTE.call(rr) && MODEL_ORIGINAL_REMOTE.call(rr).until > now(), 'unconfirmed stop does not hide running telemetry');
  assert(rr.remote() === null, 'unknown-profile engine countdown is hidden');

patches.label: verify stopped telemetry against original countdown resolver
patches.before: assert(stopped.remote() === null, 'newer stopped telemetry ends the start estimate');
patches.after: assert(MODEL_ORIGINAL_REMOTE.call(stopped) === null, 'newer stopped telemetry ends the start estimate');
